items.text: Release 5. This is the fifth release of this qualification in the TLI Transport and Logistics Training Package. The following units have been updated in the general elective units and Job roles have been updated in Description:
TLID0042 Handle furniture and effects
TLID0044 Pack and unpack furniture and effects
TLID0045 Coordinate furniture removal
TLIG0002 Lead a work team
Release 4. This is the fourth release of this qualification in the TLI Transport and Logistics Training Package with the following unit updated:
TLIF0080 Implement and monitor the safety duties of transport activities (Chain of Responsibility).
Release 3. This is third release of this qualification in the TLI Transport and Logistics Training Package. The following imported units have been updated in the general elective units:
UEGNSG007 Assess the operational capability of gas safety equipment on a delivery vehicle
UEGNSG020 Load, unload, exchange and connect industrial gas cylinders
UEGNSG031 Prepare to work in the gas industry
UEGNSG041 Apply safe working practices in the gas supply industry.
Release 2. This is second release of this qualification in the TLI Transport and Logistics Training Package. The following units have been updated in the general elective units:
TLIB0043 Pack-up mobile crane tools and lifting equipment
TLIC0031 Apply low risk car driving behaviours
TLIC0033 Apply low risk heavy vehicle driving behaviours
TLID0041 Plan and conduct specialised lift.
Release 1. This is the first release of this qualification in the TLI Transport and Logistics Training Package.
There are no entry requirements for this qualification.
